management.title: Management Services
management.content:
Ensures Defence T&E is performing as expected and continues to meet Defence's evolving needs by managing & influencing T&E Defence-wide.

  • Provided by NADG to the Ministry of Defence.
  • Evolution of existing sponsorship organisations and delivery agents.

integration.title: Integration Services
integration.content:
• Custodian of user experience, assuring technical quality and seamless interaction of individual services.
  • Provided by NADG or an emboldened independent service provider, to the Management Service.
  • New service, to be piloted and spiralled to FOC between 2028 and 2033.

userSupport.title: User Support Services
userSupport.content:
• Helps users understand T&E and find and engage the best services for their needs, and MOD to understand market health.
  • Provided by Defence Digital via ServiceNow and the Integration Provider, to users, T&E service suppliers, regulators and the Management Service.
  • Evolution of existing pilot.

teServices.title: T&E Services
teServices.content:
STEP-funded T&E Services

  • Responsive and affordable common and critical MOD owned or rented T&E capabilities, assets and services.
  • Accessible through User Support Services and provided by NADG to the Defence Enterprise.
  • Evolution of existing contracts and additional MOD T&E services funded by STEP.

Other T&E Services

  • A UK and international network of services, facilities and ranges, available for T&E.
  • Accessible through User Support Services and provided by public and private sector organisations, to the Defence Enterprise.
  • Provided through access to HMG gov't bookings, commercial frameworks and international MOUs.

innovation.title: Innovation Services
innovation.content:
• Accelerates and optimises UK T&E R&D investment and de-risks STEP investment.
  • Provided by DSTL and their ind/int partners, to the Defence Enterprise and the Management Service, with matured innovations made available as T&E and Enabling Services.
  • Evolution of Range of the Future project, T&E Futures Project as well as DASA and Transformation funds.

enabling.title: Enabling Services
enabling.content:
• Provides common enablers of T&E, where necessary to deliver the Portfolio's mission.
  • Accessible through User Support Services and provided by PAG, DSTL, DD and Commercial Providers, to the Defence Enterprise.
  • Evolution of existing policy work, pilot activity and current service provision.
